name: austrian-business-cycle-monitor
description: Austrian Business Cycle Monitor - Modern Monorepo

scripts.start:backend: cd packages/backend && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend -- --cov && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd packages/backend && poetry run ruff check . && poetry run black --check .
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend -- --fix && npm run lint:frontend -- --fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:backend: cd packages/backend && poetry run black . && poetry run ruff check . --fix
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend

author: Austrian Business Cycle Monitor Team
